title: Lance Breitstein on How the Best Traders Know Exactly When to Size Up
speaker: Lance Breitstein (guest); host Chris (tastylive)

macro_themes.view: Market is bullish (QQQ at ATH) but leadership is mixed: SanDisk/Micron, ARM, Intel, Qualcomm well off highs, so not every breakout works.
Size up only on A+ setups in play, like hot IPOs (SpaceX).

calls.reason: QQQ at ATH and 'definitely a bullish market', though momentum breadth weaker than the spring.
calls.quote: I would describe this as like yeah we're definitely in a bullish market like no no doubt about it

calls.reason: Host Chris flipped from short call spreads to long as SpaceX broke out, reasoning Tesla follows SpaceX.
calls.quote: I saw SpaceX starting to break out and if SpaceX is going then Tesla probably goes and flipped and just got long

calls.reason: Hot IPO (priced 135, opened 150, ran to 230) that host saw breaking out; guest's playbook is long hot IPOs on opening drive.
calls.quote: I saw SpaceX starting to break out

notes: Mostly a trading-process interview; calls are thin and low conviction. TSLA/SPACEX views are the host's, not the guest's. Host references 'Friday' and 'today', likely recorded Monday Oct 5 but not certain; listing date used.
